title: PIVOT — Sales by Quarter
description: Transform row-based quarterly sales data into columns using PIVOT.

data.text: Write a query that shows total sales per product, pivoted by quarter (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4).

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
WITH QuarterlySales AS (
    SELECT
        p.ProductName,
        DATEPART(QUARTER, o.OrderDate) AS Quarter,
        od.Quantity * od.UnitPrice AS Sales
    FROM Orders o
    INNER JOIN OrderDetails od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID
    INNER JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID
)
SELECT ProductName, [1] AS Q1, [2] AS Q2, [3] AS Q3, [4] AS Q4
FROM QuarterlySales
PIVOT (
    SUM(Sales)
    FOR Quarter IN ([1], [2], [3], [4])
) AS PivotTable
ORDER BY ProductName;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: PIVOT rotates rows into columns. The FOR clause specifies the column whose distinct values become new columns. The IN list defines which values to pivot. SUM(Sales) is the aggregation applied. Column names in IN must be bracketed if numeric ([1], [2]).
